Alex P.: Kickoff — partner bootcamp (hybrid) next Wed. Need final run order + who brings hardware loaners. Goal: 90-minute session, 3 mini-demos (cloud marketplace, SI integration, edge device), 30 seats in lab.
Jordan (Events): Thanks — draft runbook below. Can we confirm which partner is demoing edge HW? Need AV needs too.
Samir (Field): Edge partner confirmed: NebulaAI will bring 2 devices. They asked for a 15min slot and 1x USB-C power + HDMI out. Also want a local ethernet drop.
Linh (Product): For the marketplace demo we'll do live deploy from the marketplace tile (30s pre-auth then 5m deploy). Need someone to trigger the deployment at T+3m. Can Alex or Jordan handle that?
Alex P.: I can trigger marketplace deploy. Will need the marketplace account creds and a test subscription. @Samir can you get Nebula's network prefs?
Samir (Field): Sent Nebula's checklist to you via DM. Key point: devices use 2 static IPs; customs paperwork needed for cross-border loaners.
Tori (Ops): Shipping note — Ops can ship the loaner boxes Monday AM via FedEx Priority. Need the HS codes and pro forma invoice from Nebula by EOD Friday. Also indicate "temporary import - demo gear" to speed customs.
Jordan (Events): AV run: projector + 1x capture for stream, 2 lapel mics, one handheld for audience. Streaming encoder will pull HDMI capture of the edge device and browser tab of the marketplace UI. Anyone object?
Linh (Product): Quick checklist for demo flows (paste):
```
- Marketplace: pre-create org, marketplace tile demo account, deploy in staging, validate policy attachments
- SI integration: 10-min walkthrough of connector + live attestation of webhook (use replay URL)
- Edge device: boot, connect to local net, run inference script, show latency chart
```
Samir (Field): Backup plans: if Nebula device fails, we have a recorded demo + a VM image that runs the same inference load. If network flaps, fallback to the VM and call it out.
Alex P.: Production announcement coordination — Linh, we should sync post-event for the joint blog + marketplace listing. Can you own the post-event assets? Timeline: draft within 48h, publish after partner approval (72h).
Linh (Product): I’ll own assets. Need high-res logos and a 1-paragraph partner quote by Monday.
Tori (Ops): Shipping tracker (ship-bot): 1 box ready -> label generated: https://tracking.example/FEDEX/PKG12345 :truck:
ship-bot: Package PKG12345 created, ETA Mon 09:30 local, customs form uploaded to drive.
Jordan (Events): Rehearsal slot Friday 10:00-11:00 PT. Please bring any vendor keys and confirm remote access credentials for the stream machine.
Alex P.: I'll add the rehearsal to calendars. Final ask: one pager with run order + who speaks each minute. I'll draft and post in #partnerships by EOD. :thumbsup:
Samir (Field): Noted — I'll ensure Nebula signs the pro forma tonight and send HS codes.
Tori (Ops): Closing note — remember to mark the loaner as "temporary import" on docs or customs will hold. Also include serial numbers on the pro forma.
Jordan (Events): Good progress. See you all at rehearsal. :wave:
